تستنفون (form X)
# تَسْتَنْفُونَ (tastanfūna) /tas.tan.fuː.na/: second-person masculine plural non-past active indicative of اِسْتَنْفَى (istanfā)
# تُسْتَنْفَوْنَ (tustanfawna) /tus.tan.faw.na/: second-person masculine plural non-past passive indicative of اِسْتَنْفَى (istanfā)
